text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — want to lock owners and short deadlines so we can close this sprint.
marta: root cause recap: rotation job missed runs after a permissions change; audit-ingest retried and dropped a small window. combo caused silent token validation failures.
marta: remediation tracks: rotation guardian + perms hardening, audit backfill & validation, CI/regression for TTL edge cases, SLO + dashboard.
marta: proposed owners/date:
- kevin -> rotation guardian exporter + alert (due 2026-04-06)
- anjali -> audit backfill draft + validation query (due 2026-04-04)
- security-eng -> consolidated runbook + SLO proposal (due 2026-04-05)

kevin: I can take the guardian. Plan: exporter checks last_success and emits metric; alert pages on missed runs. PR by Tue.

kevin: example prom rule I'll wire:
```
# prom
expr: increase(rotation_last_success_missing[10m]) > 0
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

anjali: I'll draft the backfill plan. Will make it idempotent (dedupe by event_id) and run a dry-run in staging first. Need security-eng signoff on fields.

security-eng: We'll draft the runbook and propose SLO thresholds. Early suggestion: token-validation success >= 99.95% over 7d; page if <99.9% sustained 30m. We'll post rationale in doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: remediation sync scheduled Fri 09:00 PT starting 2026-04-02. Auto-reminder 24h before.

marta: Please add tracker tasks and link PRs/issues here. Owners, when you close your item post a one-line update in this thread so we can mark postmortem remediated. If any ETA slips, call it out early. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
